WITH pku_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (40388130, 432872, 619274, 619275)
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (40388130, 432872, 619274, 619275)
),
sapropterin_concepts AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS concept_id
  FROM omop.concept_ancestor
  WHERE ancestor_concept_id IN (19021959, 19128321)
  UNION SELECT concept_id FROM omop.concept WHERE concept_id IN (19021959, 19128321)
),
pku_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence
  WHERE condition_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM pku_concepts)
),
sapropterin_patients AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT person_id
  FROM omop.drug_exposure
  WHERE drug_concept_id IN (SELECT concept_id FROM sapropterin_concepts)
)
SELECT
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pku_patients) AS pku_patients,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sapropterin_patients) AS sapropterin_patients_overall,
  (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pku_patients p INNER JOIN sapropterin_patients s ON p.person_id = s.person_id) AS pku_patients_receiving_sapropterin
